name: EV charger installation
summary: Level 2 EV charger installs priced from the base install, circuit run feet, permit and trenching.

items.label: Circuit run, #6 copper in EMT, indoor
items.source: 3.6 min/ft indoor (LABOR_RATES.indoorMinutesPerFoot); #6 Cu $3.80/ft (WIRE_TABLE via recommendWire) + EMT $1.80/ft (MATERIAL_RATES); 25 ft default (index.html runFeet)

items.label: Load calculation, permit and inspection
items.source: loadCalcHours 0.75 + inspectionHours 1 (LABOR_RATES); permit & inspection fee $150 (index.html permitFee)

items.label: Trench and restoration
